topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Rain's been falling like it's got a grudge. The city's a maze of shadows and secrets, and I just got a message from Alice. Alice, a name that’s been no more than pixels on a screen until now. Says she’s in the city, less than a mile from me. Heart’s beating like it's trying to escape, but I don’t let it show. Meet up, she suggests. I’ve seen the way smiles fade when the lights go down, the hollow promises and the colder streets. This city wears many masks, and Alice might just be another one. I type back, fingers hesitant, suggesting a neutral spot, a public place. Better to keep the cards close, especially when someone’s upping the stakes just by being in the same zip code.
